challenges.prompt: Complete squareAll: results are collected by original index, negative inputs produce per-item errors ("item N: negative input") combined with errors.Join in sorted order, and a cancelled context returns ctx.Err(). Three runs show success, partial failure and cancellation.

[1 4 9 16 25] <nil>

context canceled
challenges.explain: Workers read indexes from a jobs channel, results carry their original index so order is preserved, a goroutine closes results after the WaitGroup, and the producer stops on ctx.Done(). Verified by running the solution with go run.

challenges.title: Test an HTTP handler with httptest
